title: Customizations
description: V7 — How it runs: V5's session panel and Library, with a "How it runs" view that lays the session's customizations along the agent loop (session start → each prompt → while the agent works → when it stops), with a context estimate, overrides and duplicates, and what doesn't apply and why. Rows drill in (V2's pattern). "Where it's from" keeps V5's by-source view.
